data.summary: This two‑week plan tackles the student’s weak unit (Unit 6) first, then reviews key concepts from Units 1–5 and 7–8 before the exam. Each week is limited to 10 study hours and includes concrete tasks that can be completed in a single sitting.

weeks.focus: Master Unit 6 and reinforce core differentiation concepts
tasks: Do 15 Riemann sum practice problems and check solutions
Solve 10 definite integral problems using the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
Complete a 20‑question quiz on the Power Rule and its applications
Review 5 sample AP questions on accumulation functions and mark them against the scoring guide

weeks.focus: Review all units and timed practice
tasks: Take a 60‑minute timed practice test covering all units
Identify and correct 5 mistakes from the practice test
Create a one‑page cheat sheet summarizing key formulas and theorems
Do a 30‑minute review session on related rates and slope fields

data.final_week_advice: Use the final week for a full-length timed practice test and a thorough review of any remaining weak spots. Focus on pacing and accuracy, and ensure all formulas are memorized before the exam.
